timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,498.5 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently weak at around 1,498–1,500 KRW per USD, meaning you need more won to get your $2,000. News headlines indicate the high exchange rate is persisting despite export growth, and the market is searching for direction around the 1,500 level with no clear strengthening signal yet.

TIP: Consider waiting for won strength (lower KRW/USD rate) before converting, or if you must convert monthly, split purchases across multiple dates to average out the weak won period.
